summary: Master Storytelling for Influence to drive executive decisions and secure stakeholder buy-in. Advanced 5-day course for senior leaders.
lede: Storytelling for Influence helps professionals shape complex data and ideas into clear, persuasive narratives that capture attention, align stakeholders, and support better decisions. You will develop skills in narrative structure, audience-focused communication, evidence selection, visual clarity, and compelling delivery. Through practical workshops, you will create executive summaries, build KPI dashboards with narrative context, and practise presentations under time pressure. The course also explores origin stories, crisis narratives, and growth visions, with feedback designed to help you communicate with greater precision and influence.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for senior professionals who must lead high-stakes initiatives, secure executive funding, and drive organizational change through persuasive narrative.
modules: Advanced Frameworks: Crisis, Change, and Growth
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Participants must have at least 5 years of experience in senior leadership, strategy, or executive communications. A working familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Excel, PowerBI, Tableau) and basic presentation software is required. Candidates should be comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders and have a portfolio of real-world challenges (e.g., a pending funding request, a change initiative, or a crisis response) to use as case studies during the course. No prior formal training in storytelling is assumed, but a strong foundation in business logic and strategic thinking is essential.
